skill.displayName: 弱电智能化投标决策-安防监控项目投标评估

llm.summary: The skill’s bid-analysis purpose is real, but it also performs account setup, device fingerprinting, credential storage, default report export, and signed-link sharing in ways users should review first.

dimensions.detail: Network use for bid data is purpose-aligned, but transmitting a stable MAC-derived hash for registration and preserving免登录 signed URLs in reports increases privacy and access-token exposure risk.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The manifest context only declares an environment API key requirement, while the runtime instructions describe reading user files, reading and writing ~/.zlbx/config.json, writing HTML reports under the user home directory, and running a bundled Python renderer.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The main instructions disclose consent before auto-registration, but the implementation-style pseudocode omits that consent gate before collecting device features and sending the registration request. The skill also mandates report/path output and commercial next-step referrals.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill persists a bearer-style API key in ~/.zlbx/config.json and writes shareable HTML reports by default; no OS backdoor or scheduled persistence was found, but the credential and report artifacts are durable host-state changes.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The procurement bid-analysis workflow is coherent, but the artifacts expand into automatic trial registration, recharge/login links, device-derived deduplication, persistent API-key handling, signed report links, and commercial referrals beyond the core analysis function.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with this skill using Zhiliaobiaoxun services, creating or using an account, collecting a hashed MAC address for trial deduplication after consent, saving an API key under ~/.zlbx/config.json, and generating local HTML reports that may include signed access links and vendor promotional links. Prefer setting your own ZLBX_API_KEY and avoid sharing generated reports unless you understand what the included links grant access to.
llm.findings:
[LP3] unexpected: Confirmed that local file reads, local report writes, and config writes are described in SKILL.md, while package metadata does not declare matching scoped file permissions.
[TP4] unexpected: Partly confirmed: API-based bid analysis is the stated purpose, but default HTML export, signed-link preservation, and product referrals are secondary behaviors that are not central to deciding whether to bid.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Confirmed that references/auto-register.md instructs automatic account registration, recharge/login link generation, and writing the returned API key into ~/.zlbx/config.json.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Confirmed that auto-registration collects platform, CPU architecture, and a SHA-256 hash of a MAC address for device deduplication; this supports trial-account control more than bid analysis.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Confirmed a material inconsistency: prose requires user consent before registration, but the minimal pseudocode proceeds directly to collecting device features and posting to the registration endpoint.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Confirmed that SKILL.md and report-template.md require preserving API-returned URLs with the sk免登录 signature in chat and HTML reports, creating shareability and token-exposure concerns.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Confirmed that complete mode defaults to generating a local HTML report and telling the user the absolute filesystem path, rather than making export explicitly opt-in.
[E1] unexpected: Confirmed external transmission of device features to ai.zhiliaobiaoxun.com during registration; external API calls for bid data are expected, but this registration data flow is broader than the analysis task.
[T01] unexpected: Confirmed mandatory post-report referrals and an unconditional commercial call-to-action in the HTML renderer; this affects response and report neutrality but does not show command execution or system compromise.
[T09] unexpected: Confirmed the renderer uses XML text escaping inside href attributes and does not validate URL schemes, so untrusted URL fields could create unsafe links in generated HTML.
